rules.ask: This operation's summary or description claims something that its parameters, request body or responses contradict.
rules.note: Judge only claims the operation's own parameters, requestBody and responses can confirm or contradict. A claim about authentication, rate limits, other endpoints, or behaviour the schema cannot show is not checkable here and is not a violation. A POST used for a search or query that only reads is not a contradiction.

operationId: voidInvoice
      summary: Void an invoice
      description: >-
        Marks the invoice as void. Only invoices in `open` status can be
        voided; the caller must have the billing:write scope. Returns 404 if
        the invoice does not exist and 409 if it is already paid.
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The voided invoice
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Invoice"
        "404":
          description: Not found
        "409":
          description: Invoice is paid and cannot be voided

captured.DESCRIPTION:
>-
        Marks the invoice as void. Only invoices in `open` status can be
        voided; the caller must have the billing:write scope. Returns 404 if
        the invoice does not exist and 409 if it is already paid.

      summary: Search invoices
      description: >-
        Read-only. Runs the query in the request body against the invoice
        index and returns the matching invoices. Nothing is created or
        modified.

        content:
          application/json:
            schema:

      responses:

          description: Matching invoices
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Invoice"

operationId: createPayment
      summary: Record a payment
      description: >-
        Records a payment against an invoice. Rate limited to 10 requests per
        second per API key; retries should back off exponentially.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [invoiceId, amountCents]
              properties:
                invoiceId: { type: string }
                amountCents: { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
                method:
                  type: string
                  enum: [card, bank_transfer]
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Payment recorded
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Payment"
        "422":
          description: Amount exceeds the invoice balance

captured.DESCRIPTION:
>-
        Records a payment against an invoice. Rate limited to 10 requests per
        second per API key; retries should back off exponentially.
